title: EcoCard: How to Earn Sustainability Points on Green Purchases
summary: Explains how EcoCard sustainability points are earned: $5.00 points per $1 spent on qualifying green purchases (certified green merchants/categories) and $1.00 points per $1 on other purchases. Includes how to maximize green earnings, example $100 earn calculations, and guidance for mixed carts, receipt saving, and point reversals on refunds/returns.
faqs: What are EcoCard sustainability point earn rates for green purchases vs other purchases?
How can I make sure a purchase earns the higher $5.00-per-$1 green rate (in-store and online)?
If my cart has both green and non-green items at a non-partner merchant, which earn rate applies?
What happens to sustainability points if I return or get a refund for a transaction?
How many sustainability points will I earn from a $100 purchase at a qualifying green merchant versus a non-green merchant?
What should I do to handle an earn-rate dispute if I think my purchase should qualify as green?
keywords: green categories (public transit, EV charging, renewable energy subscriptions)
